## React Twins

`react/taskboard/` and `react/helpdesk/` are the same apps in idiomatic React,
with the same files, names, and call paths. taskboard uses TSX function
components, zustand stores shaped like the Pinia stores, and react-router.
helpdesk uses JSX class components, Redux thunks named after the Vuex actions,
class inheritance in place of mixins, and the same event bus. They are the
parity target: they show what the provider already extracts for each construct
when it is written in a form the JavaScript engine understands.

Each twin's `twin-map.json` maps the Vue facts onto it:

```json
{"vue_ext": ".tsx", "files": {"src/router/index.ts": "src/router/index.tsx"},
 "names": {"src/views/X.vue#created": "componentDidMount"},
 "no_counterpart": {"<fact key>": "reason"}}
```

A `.vue` path maps to the twin extension unless `files` says otherwise, a
symbol keeps its name unless `names` renames it, and the Vue-only kinds
`component`, `document`, and `element` are dropped. `no_counterpart` lists facts
React has no equivalent for, such as custom-event channels, attribute traps,
and `<script src>`.

  file that declares the mapped name.

  comparable facts, and the Vue score on those same facts. It is a report, not a
  ratchet.

open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

Address Bugbot findings on the records spool
- Spool writes always report success again: a cache-disk failure is
  remembered and surfaces from Store, which abandons the entry, instead of
  aborting the snapshot stream mid-output through the io.MultiWriter tee.
  This restores the exact contract the bounded in-memory capture had.
- finish closes the temporary file exactly once before any discard, so a
  failed compressor close or flush no longer leaks the handle (on Windows
  removing a still-open file fails and left .stream-* leftovers behind).
- The unwritable-cache-dir test blocks with a regular file at the cache
  path instead of a 0o500 directory, which Windows does not honor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Entire-Checkpoint: 81617a0c52c1

Spool provider-record cache writes to disk so large snapshots cache again
The cache tee buffered a cold run's record stream uncompressed in memory,
capped at 64MB; past the cap the entry was silently never stored, so any
repository whose snapshot stream exceeded 64MB re-parsed on every run.
Measured on entire-brain (130MB stream): repeat snapshot 34s on main vs
1.0s on v0.4.0, with no warning anywhere.

input.command:
gofmt -l internal cmd; go vet ./... 2>&1 | grep -vE "null character|go-tree-sitter/|^\s+[0-9]+ \||^\s+\||^#" | head -5; go build ./... && echo build-ok; git add docs/language-support.md internal/sem/vue.go internal/sem/vue_test.go internal/sem/parser.go internal/sem/provider.go internal/sem/identity_revision_test.go internal/sem/language_matrix_test.go internal/sem/testdata/langmatrix/vue internal/sem/testdata/fixtures internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/score.json && git status --short | grep -v "^ M .claude" && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Parse Vue single-file component script blocks

.vue files were inventory-only: one whole-file component symbol plus
HTML-id elements, and the <script> was never read, so functions and
classes written in components had no symbols at all.

A component now parses through a view of itself in which every byte
outside the top-level <script> and <script setup> bodies is blanked and
newlines are kept, so lines, columns and byte offsets are those of the
file. The view parses under the script's own grammar (lang ts, tsx, jsx,
or JavaScript by default) through the same path as .ts/.js files, the
Flow JavaScript precedent: swap the grammar, keep the label "Vue". A
component without a parseable script keeps the old extraction.

- parseWithSpec is ParseWithStatusCtx minus spec selection; the .tsx
  mask choice is a flag instead of the file extension.
- The component, document and element symbols keep their IDs. Entity
  order makes the component the container of top-level script
  declarations while elements stay under the document.
- Vue joins the semantic languages with a language-matrix fixture.
  Relations (calls, imports) come in a follow-up, so Vue does not yet
  advertise CALLS.
- IdentityRevision moves to 10: unchanged .vue trees gain symbols.

Vue corpus: 226 -> 315 of 622 (script-symbols 37/40, options-api 41/52,
component-owner CONTAINS 10), with no fact lost.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -4

git status --short | grep -v "^ M .claude"; git add internal/sem/vue.go internal/sem/provider.go internal/sem/types.go internal/sem/langcompat.go internal/sem/search_container_map.go internal/sem/declaration_line.go internal/sem/js_scopes.go internal/sem/records_cache.go internal/sem/search_cache.go internal/sem/capability_relation_union_test.go internal/sem/golden_test.go internal/sem/language_matrix_test.go internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/vue-basic internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/vue-basic.ndjson.golden internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/quality_coverage.json internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/score.json && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Resolve Vue component scripts through the JavaScript relation passes

Component scripts had symbols but no relations: every relation scanner
keys on the file's language, and "Vue" matched none of them.

Two seams cover the whole relation phase instead of every gate:
- forEachRelation wraps readContent, so each reread of a .vue file
  returns its script view (template blanked, offsets kept) and no scanner
  can see markup. A component without a parseable script reads blank.
- The per-file worker analyses a Vue file as TypeScript, the superset of
  its script dialects; the records it emits keep "Vue". Symbol-level TS
  rules, signature types, private-name checks and the JS/TS type-sharing
  group go through scriptAnalysisLanguage. The TypeScript fallback that
  resolves a receiver call to any same-named method of the caller's
  container stays TypeScript-only: in a component it would bind
  `ticket.save()` to the component's own `save`.

The component, document and element symbols are left out of the worker's
symbol set, so the whole-file component neither calls everything nor
blanks the top-level script. Route, service and channel scans stay off for
components, which consume routes rather than declare them; shared
emit/listen patterns would read Vuex dispatch as an event. The scope scan
parses a component's view as TypeScript, then TSX.

Vue now advertises CALLS and TypeScript's relations less the GraphQL and
tRPC handlers, pinned by a relation probe, a vue-basic golden fixture and
the language matrix. Relation cache versions move (records v26, search
v31).

Vue corpus: 315 -> 345 of 622 (script-calls 18/19, Options API this-calls
47/52, prop types 7/14), with no fact lost. `neighbors --direction in` on a
helper called only from a component now lists that component's function.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -5

Resolve imports from and into Vue components

Component scripts now parse and resolve calls, but their imports did not
resolve: every import gate keyed on .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx, and the module index
held only those files, so `import X from './X.vue'` inside a component and
`import('@/views/X.vue')` in a router both ended at external endpoints.

- .vue joins the JavaScript import scanner and imported-name map. Both
  read the script view, so template text never yields an import.
- Relative imports from a component resolve like those from a .ts file.
- The manifest resolver accepts .vue importers, so tsconfig `paths`
  aliases (`@/...`) resolve from components, and components enter the
  module index keyed WITH their extension: they are imported as
  `X.vue`, and a sibling `X.ts` must not compete for the bare `X`.
- jsImporterExtension carries the .vue case; jsLikeExtension, which also
  gates the Express and NestJS passes, is unchanged.

A test pins that the fast profile never precomputes a component's imports
from raw content. Relation cache versions move (records v27, search v32).

Vue corpus: 345 -> 385 of 622 (script imports 18/18, taskboard @/ aliases
17/17 and lazy routes 6/7), with no fact lost. helpdesk's aliases come
from jsconfig.json, which the provider does not read yet.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Resolve imports from and into Vue components

Component scripts now parse and resolve calls, but their imports did not
resolve: every import gate keyed on .js/.jsx/.ts/.tsx, and the module index
held only those files, so `import X from './X.vue'` inside a component and
`import('@/views/X.vue')` in a router both ended at external endpoints.

- .vue joins the JavaScript import scanner and imported-name map. Both
  read the script view, so template text never yields an import.
- Relative imports from a component resolve like those from a .ts file.
- The manifest resolver accepts .vue importers, so tsconfig `paths`
  aliases (`@/...`) resolve from components, and components enter the
  module index keyed WITH their extension: they are imported as
  `X.vue`, and a sibling `X.ts` must not compete for the bare `X`.
- jsImporterExtension carries the .vue case; jsLikeExtension, which also
  gates the Express and NestJS passes, is unchanged.

A test pins that the fast profile never precomputes a component's imports
from raw content. Relation cache versions move (records v27, search v32).

Vue corpus: 345 -> 385 of 622 (script imports 18/18, taskboard @/ aliases
17/17 and lazy routes 6/7), with no fact lost. helpdesk's aliases come
from jsconfig.json, which the provider does not read yet.

Attribute a Vue component's setup calls and macro types to the component

A <script setup> body is the component's setup function, but its
top-level calls (useFilters(), load()) were attributed to the file, and
the types it declares through compiler macros were invisible: a component
had no edge to the Props it takes. A function component in React has both,
through its body and its props parameter.

- The top-level call scan of a .vue file uses the component symbol as its
  source, so those calls come from the component.
- The parser records the type arguments of defineProps, defineEmits,
  defineModel and defineSlots (withDefaults included) as the component's
  parameter types. The signature-type pass admits a component only when
  such types were recorded, and resolves them with the usual type
  resolver, so local interfaces and imported types both land as
  PARAM_TYPE. A component without recorded types, a Svelte one included,
  still names none.

Relation cache versions move (records v28, search v33); no symbol changes.

Vue corpus: 385 -> 398 of 622 (component-owner 12/16, prop types 13/14),
with no fact lost. The four component calls left are to Pinia stores,
which are `const useX = defineStore(...)` and need const-bound factories
to be call targets, a JavaScript-wide change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

Resolve Vue mixins and extends as component inheritance

An Options API component that lists `mixins: [paginationMixin]` or
`extends: BaseListView` answers `this.nextPage()` with the mixin's method,
but the graph had no edge to the mixin and no target for the call. React's
equivalent, a class extending a base class, gets both.

- A pre-pass resolves each component's extends and mixins identifiers to
  a same-file declaration or, through the component's imports, to the
  named export (or, for a .vue file, the component) they name. The worker
  emits EXTENDS for extends and INHERITS for each mixin; EXTENDS feeds
  override derivation, so a component that redefines its base's method
  gets OVERRIDES.
- Before any worker reads methodsByContainer, the parents' methods are
  merged into the component as Vue merges them: the component's own
  methods win, later mixins win over earlier ones, mixins win over the
  extends base, and a parent is merged before its children. `this.x()`
  then resolves through the existing receiver lookup, and merged entries
  keep their own IDs, so override derivation sees no false override.
- An alias the import resolver cannot read (jsconfig.json, bundler alias)
  falls back to the one file whose path ends in the aliased path; such an
  edge is labelled `pattern`, not `import_resolved`.

Relation cache versions move (records v29, search v34).

last mixin fact lives in a <script src> file.

Follow <script src> from a Vue component to its external script

A component may keep its script in another file: `<script src="./x.js">`.
The component had no edge to that file, and options declared there, such
as its mixins, never reached the component.

- A .vue file's imports include each script src. The tag is blank in the
  script view, so forEachRelation keeps the raw reader beside the masked
  one for this.
- When a component's inline script is empty, the mixin and extends pass
  reads its options from the src script, and resolves their imports
  relative to that file.

The external script's methods stay that file's own symbols: making them
children of the component would put a container across files.

A unit test covers src extraction, and vue-basic pins a src component's
import and mixin. Relation cache versions move (records v32, search v37).

Vue corpus: 448 -> 451 of 622 (script-src 3/7), with no fact lost.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
git log --oneline -12

| `explain` | Resolves symbols named by a failing build or test into definitions and context. |
| `neighbors` | Direct relations of one symbol (`--relation`, `--direction`, `--depth 1\|2`). Ambiguous names return a definition list; disambiguate with `--file`. |
| `impact` | One-shot blast radius for a symbol: direct and transitive callers (depth ≤ 2), callees, type consumers, data flows, co-change files, siblings. |

Callers come from `CALLS` edges only. For a Go function or method, `neighbors`
(direction `in` or `both`) and `impact` add a `W_VALUE_REFERENCES_UNMODELLED`
warning to JSON and one line to agent and text output: references to the
function as a value (assigned to a variable, passed as an argument, stored in a
struct field or map) are not modelled, and the line gives a `grep` that finds
them. Any non-comment hit that is not a call is a dependent the graph cannot see.

symbol of the same name, so it is disclosed, not counted as a caller.

disclosure, kept out of the completeness banners, which report only the

content.text:
The Vue-specific plan is fully implemented as 11 local commits on `vue-corpus`, none pushed. On the scored corpus, Vue went from **206 to 451 of 622** facts (the plan targeted ~442), and no fact was lost at any step. The full test suite passes (`go test ./...`), and `gofmt` and `go vet` are clean. I did not run the race-enabled `mise run check`.

On the 568 facts that have a React equivalent, Vue now scores **420 against the React twins' 384**. When an agent asks Graph about code used by Vue components, it now gets real answers instead of "0 callers":

- `neighbors` on `useFilters` lists the `BoardView` component.
- `impact` on `relativeDueLabel` lists `dueText` in `TaskDetailPanel.vue`.
- The Vuex action `fetchTickets` shows its three callers, marked `pattern, requires_verification` because they're matched from strings.
- The mixin method `nextPage` shows `TicketList.handleKeydown`.

| Commit | Change | Corpus |
|---|---|---|
| `057ffe60` | Corpus, React twins, and a parity report in the test | 206 |
| `e0bc23c4` | HTML ids only from literal `id=` (no more fake elements from `:task-id=`) | 226 |
| `020d7285` | Parse `<script>` / `<script setup>` under their own JS/TS grammar | 315 |
| `94dbe5cd` | Calls from Vue scripts resolve like TypeScript; the records still say Vue | 345 |
| `e389d440` | Imports from and into `.vue` files, including `@/` aliases | 385 |
| `22a86389` | Setup calls and `defineProps<T>()` types belong to the component | 398 |
| `41f77c74` | Mixins and `extends`, with `this.x()` reaching mixin methods | 412 |
| `bb123214` | `$emit`/`$on` and event-bus channels | 429 |
| `0841608c` | Vuex `dispatch`, `commit`, getters, and `mapActions` strings | 448 |
| `0e5d43a5` | `<script src>` external scripts | 451 |
| `bcc4ec88` | `impact`/`neighbors` warn when unparsed files (Svelte, Astro, HTML…) mention the symbol | n/a |

**Deviations from the plan:**
- I did PR1 (the unparsed-file warning) last, since parsing Vue made it unnecessary for Vue. It still covers Svelte and other formats Graph only lists.
- I moved the "Vue advertises CALLS" capability change from PR2a to PR2b. Turning it on before the relation changes would have scanned template text as code.
- Where a mixin import can't be resolved, because `jsconfig.json` isn't read yet, I fall back to matching a unique file path. Those edges are labelled `pattern`, not `import_resolved`, so they're visibly lower-confidence.
- For searches, a query naming a script function ranks that function first. A descriptive query can still rank the component's template first, which matches how the React twin ranks.

**Still missing, all outside the agreed scope** (React mostly misses these too):
- template and JSX edges, such as `<TaskCard>` and `@click` (77 facts, waiting on your relation-type decision)
- the shared JavaScript fixes: Pinia and other store calls, arrow-function getters, `jsconfig.json`, vitest/jest test edges, and the false-positive patterns (about 103 facts)

Your `.claude/settings.json` change is still uncommitted, and Brain background work is still paused. Pushing and opening the PR (or PRs) is yours, as usual. I can also draft the JavaScript-track issues for you to review before anything is filed.

## Why

`.vue` files were inventory-only: Graph kept a whole-file component symbol and HTML-id elements, and never parsed `<script>`. `impact` and `neighbors` answered "0 callers" for any function used only by Vue components, as confidently as a real zero.

## What Changes

Each commit is a self-contained step and can be reviewed in order.

1. **Scored Vue corpus** (`internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus`). Two Vue apps (Vue 3 with `<script setup lang="ts">` and Pinia, and Options API with Vuex and mixins) with 622 hand-written ground-truth facts, plus React twins of both apps as the parity target. `TestVueCorpusScore` ratchets `score.json`.
2. **Literal HTML ids only.** `data-id=`, `:task-id=`, `:id=` and `v-bind:id=` no longer create element symbols.
3. **Script parsing.** A component parses through a view of itself with everything outside `<script>`/`<script setup>` blanked and newlines kept, under the script's own grammar (`lang` ts, tsx, jsx, or JavaScript). The label stays `Vue`, like Flow JavaScript under the TSX grammar.
4. **Relations.** The relation phase rereads `.vue` files as their script view and analyzes them as TypeScript, while emitted records keep `Vue`.
5. **Imports** from and into components, including `@/` tsconfig aliases.
6. **Component ownership.** Top-level setup calls and `defineProps<T>()`/`defineEmits<T>()` types belong to the component.
7. **Mixins and `extends`.** INHERITS/EXTENDS edges, `this.x()` resolving into mixin methods, and OVERRIDES across `extends`.
8. **Events.** `$emit`/`$on` and event-bus channels. Vuex `dispatch` is not treated as an event.
9. **Vuex strings.** `dispatch`, `commit`, getters and `mapActions`/`mapGetters` resolve to store members at `pattern` resolution.
10. **`<script src>`** external scripts.
11. **Disclosure.** `impact` and `neighbors` name inventory-only files (Svelte, Astro, HTML, and others) that mention the symbol, with a new `W_INVENTORY_MENTIONS_UNMODELLED` warning.

## Measured

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Vue corpus facts | 206 / 622 | 451 / 622 |
| Facts with a React counterpart: Vue | 205 / 568 | 420 / 568 |
| Same facts: React twins | 384 / 568 | 384 / 568 |

No corpus fact was lost at any step.

## Contract and Caches

- Schema unchanged, no egress, existing component, document and element IDs unchanged.
- `IdentityRevision` 8 → 10 (phantom elements dropped; components gain script symbols). Records cache v25 → v32 and search cache v30 → v37 for the relation changes.
- Vue is a semantic language: `docs/language-support.md`, a language-matrix fixture, a capability probe, and a `vue-basic` golden fixture. Other goldens changed only in their `identity_revision` header.

## Out of Scope

- **Template and JSX edges** (`<TaskCard>`, `@click`), pending a choice between reusing CALLS and adding a RENDERS type.
- **JavaScript resolution gaps React shares:** Pinia and other store calls through instances, arrow-function getters, `jsconfig.json` aliases, vitest/jest TESTS edges, nested sibling calls, multi-line and aliased imports, and the false CALLS to Vuex `state()` and false HANDLES_ROUTE on HTTP wrappers.

## Testing

`go test ./...` passes; `gofmt` and `go vet` are clean. The race-enabled `mise run check` was not run.

content.text:
The review raised 10 findings. I checked each against the code, and all hold up. One is a crash; the rest are wrong edges, missed coverage, or wasted work.

**Crash (the reviewer confirmed it by running code):**
- `vueScriptBlocks`/`vueSkipBlock` index a `strings.ToLower` copy with offsets from the original, but `ToLower` changes byte length for characters like `İ` or the Kelvin sign. A template containing one can shift the script boundaries or cause an out-of-range slice. Since every snapshot of such a repo would crash, this one must be fixed.

**Wrong or misleading edges:**
- `@vueuse/core`-style scoped packages are treated as `@/` aliases.
- Exported variables that wrap callables (such as mixin objects) also emit Vuex CALLS.
- Vue `extends` emits EXTENDS without the INHERITS pair that TypeScript classes get.
- Redux's `createStore(` switches on the Vuex scan.
- The disclosure says "1 file mention" instead of "mentions".

**Missed coverage:**
- Top-level `<script setup>` Vuex calls are missed.
- Extensionless `.vue` imports (common in Vue CLI projects) don't resolve.
- Functions called only from templates get a silent zero.

**Cost:**
- The Vuex index re-reads every JS/TS file even in non-Vue repos.
- The script view is recomputed on every reread.
- The mention scan has no byte cap.

I'll fix all ten as themed follow-up commits, in the repo's "Address … findings" style, rather than rewriting the 11 reviewed commits. Edits wait until the background race run finishes, since it compiles from the working tree. Meanwhile, reading the conventions the fixes need: the HTTP scan's callable gate, how CALLS pick `RelationScope`, and how class `extends` pairs EXTENDS with INHERITS.

For the Vuex scan I'll skip `variable` symbols. The scope label will follow the existing convention: `file` for same-file targets, `module` otherwise.

Finding #7 holds: for a class, `typeRelationsForFile` emits INHERITS alongside every EXTENDS, so Vue's `extends` should too.

  so a scoped package such as `@vueuse/core` is never matched against
  local files.

  `@/components/Base`) as Vue CLI and webpack projects do, with .vue
  tried after the script extensions.
- Memoize each component's script view for the relation pass, which
  rereads components many times.

without the fix. vue-basic now imports a component without its

11	3. **Script parsing.** A component parses through a view of itself with everything outside `<script>`/`<script setup>` blanked and newlines kept, under the script's own grammar (`lang` ts, tsx, jsx, or JavaScript). The label stays `Vue`, like Flow JavaScript under the TSX grammar.
12	4. **Relations.** The relation phase rereads `.vue` files as their script view and analyzes them as TypeScript, while emitted records keep `Vue`.
13	5. **Imports** from and into components, including `@/` tsconfig aliases.
14	6. **Component ownership.** Top-level setup calls and `defineProps<T>()`/`defineEmits<T>()` types belong to the component.
15	7. **Mixins and `extends`.** INHERITS/EXTENDS edges, `this.x()` resolving into mixin methods, and OVERRIDES across `extends`.
16	8. **Events.** `$emit`/`$on` and event-bus channels. Vuex `dispatch` is not treated as an event.
17	9. **Vuex strings.** `dispatch`, `commit`, getters and `mapActions`/`mapGetters` resolve to store members at `pattern` resolution.
18	10. **`<script src>`** external scripts.
19	11. **Disclosure.** `impact` and `neighbors` name the files where a mention cannot be modelled: inventory-only files (Svelte, Astro, HTML, and others) and Vue templates. A new `W_INVENTORY_MENTIONS_UNMODELLED` warning carries it.
20	12. **Review fixes** (last three commits). An independent review of the branch found 10 issues, all fixed with regression tests:
21	    - A crash: block boundaries were found on a `strings.ToLower` copy, which changes byte length for `İ`, the Kelvin sign and invalid UTF-8. A template containing one could slice out of range.
22	    - Scoped packages (`@vueuse/core`) matched as path aliases.
23	    - Vuex calls in `<script setup>` top-level code and `computed()` arrows were missed.
24	    - Redux's `createStore` switched the Vuex scans on, and non-Vue repositories read every script file for nothing.
25	    - `extends` lacked its INHERITS pair, and variables wrapping methods were counted as callers.
26	    - Extensionless `.vue` imports did not resolve.
27	    - The script view was recomputed on every reread.

content.text:
No commit is unnecessary: each one changes behavior and comes with its own tests. There is avoidable churn inside them, though, because I bumped versions and folded in fixes per commit as if each were a separate PR, while the trail ships them as one change.

| Commit | Needed? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `057ffe60` corpus and React twins | Yes, though partly optional | It's ~240 test files. The Vue corpus is the guard. The 119 React-twin files only feed a log-only parity report, so they could be dropped to slim the trail. |
| `e0bc23c4` to `bcc4ec88` (10 feature commits) | Yes | Each adds a distinct capability, with corpus gains and no fact lost. |
| `567f24b6`, `df8d40b3`, `7dae62ee` (review fixes) | Needed as content, not as separate commits | They correct code from earlier commits in this same trail, so a reviewer reads code and then its fix. They could be folded into the commits they repair. |

The real waste:

- **`IdentityRevision` bumped three times (8 → 9 → 10 → 11).** Each bump rewrote the header line of the same 29 unrelated goldens, 87 noise lines in all. Since everything merges together, a single bump (8 → 9) does the same job, and revisions 10 and 11 would never exist in any release.
- **Cache versions bumped nine times each** (records v25 → v34, search v30 → v39). One bump each is enough.

I'd rewrite the branch into 11 commits:

- the review fixes folded into the commits they correct
- one `IdentityRevision` bump and one cache bump, in the first commits that need them
- optionally, the React twins removed

The final code would be unchanged, which I'd confirm with an empty diff against the current head before pushing. The catch is that the branch is already published on trail #2925. The rewrite needs a force-push to `vue-corpus`, which restarts the trail's agent review on the new head.

Do you want that cleanup, with or without the React twins? Or leave the history as is, which is accurate, just noisier.

"""Fold the review fixes into the step they belong to, and every later step.

usage: python3 -I foldins.py STEP HEAD_DIR   (run from the repository root)
Steps 3..9 only; steps 10 and 11 take whole files from HEAD_DIR instead.
"""
import os
import shutil
import sys

STEP = int(sys.argv[1])
HEAD = sys.argv[2]


def read(path):
    return open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()


def write(path, text):
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)


def edit(path, pairs):
    text = read(path)
    for old, new in pairs:
        count = text.count(old)
        if count != 1:
            raise SystemExit(f"{path}: anchor found {count} times: {old[:80]!r}")
        text = text.replace(old, new)
    write(path, text)


def func_text(src, name):
    """The function named name, with the comment block directly above it."""
    start = src.index(f"\nfunc {name}(") + 1
    while True:
        prev_end = src.rfind("\n", 0, start - 1)
        line = src[prev_end + 1:start - 1]
        if line.startswith("//"):
            start = prev_end + 1
            continue
        break
    end = src.index("\n}\n", start) + 3
    return src[start:end]


def head(path):
    return read(os.path.join(HEAD, path))


VUE = "internal/sem/vue.go"
PROVIDER = "internal/sem/provider.go"
TEST = "internal/sem/vue_test.go"
head_vue, head_provider, head_test = head(VUE), head(PROVIDER), head(TEST)


def append_test(name):
    text = read(TEST)
    if f"\nfunc {name}(" in text:
        raise SystemExit(f"{name} already present")
    write(TEST, text.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + func_text(head_test, name))


def replace_func(path, head_src, name):
    text = read(path)
    write(path, text.replace(func_text(text, name), func_text(head_src, name)))


def copy_head(path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(os.path.join(HEAD, path), path)


# Step 3: script parsing -- block boundaries on an ASCII-only lowercase copy.
if STEP >= 3:
    edit(VUE, [
        ("\tvar blocks []vueScriptBlock\n\tlower := strings.ToLower(content)",
         "\tvar blocks []vueScriptBlock\n\tlower := asciiLower(content)"),
        ("func vueTagNameEnds(lower string, at int) bool {",
         func_text(head_vue, "asciiLower") + "\nfunc vueTagNameEnds(lower string, at int) bool {"),
    ])
    append_test("TestVueScriptViewWithLengthChangingCharacters")

# Step 4: relation seam -- one script view per component per pass.
if STEP >= 4:
    edit(VUE, [('\t"regexp"\n\t"strings"\n)', '\t"regexp"\n\t"strings"\n\t"sync"\n)')])
    replace_func(VUE, head_vue, "vueScriptReader")

# Step 5: imports -- extensionless component imports.
if STEP >= 5:
    edit(PROVIDER, [
        ('\tbase := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(importingPath), spec))\n\texts := []string{".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx"}',
         '\tbase := filepath.ToSlash(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(importingPath), spec))\n'
         '\t// .vue comes last: Vue CLI and webpack projects list it in\n'
         '\t// resolve.extensions, so `import Base from \'./Base\'` names Base.vue when no\n'
         '\t// script file of that name exists.\n'
         '\texts := []string{".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".jsx", ".vue"}'),
    ])
    replace_func(PROVIDER, head_provider, "(resolver manifestImportResolver) resolveJSModulePath")
    append_test("TestJSLocalImportCandidatesReachExtensionlessComponents")

# Step 7: mixins -- root aliases only, INHERITS beside EXTENDS, extensionless fixture import.
if STEP >= 7:
    replace_func(VUE, head_vue, "vueAliasSuffixTarget")
    replace_func(TEST, head_test, "TestVueAliasSuffixTarget")
    edit(PROVIDER, [(
        "\t\t\t\t\tif r.Type == \"EXTENDS\" {\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tresult.inheritance = append(result.inheritance, r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\temit(r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t}",
        "\t\t\t\t\tif r.Type == \"EXTENDS\" {\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tresult.inheritance = append(result.inheritance, r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\temit(r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\t// As for a class, extending a component also inherits its\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\t// members, so EXTENDS carries its INHERITS pair.\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tif spec.emits(\"INHERITS\") {\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\t\tr.Type = \"INHERITS\"\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\t\temit(r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\temit(r)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t}",
    )])
    copy_head("internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/vue-basic/src/TaskPage.vue")

# Step 9: Vuex -- index gating, top-level calls, method (not variable) callers, scope.
if STEP >= 9:
    vuex_vars_old = "\tvuexRootRe          = regexp.MustCompile(`\\b(?:Vuex\\s*\\.\\s*Store|createStore)\\s*\\(`)\n"
    vuex_vars_new = (
        "\tvuexStoreCtorRe     = regexp.MustCompile(`\\bVuex\\s*\\.\\s*Store\\s*\\(`)\n"
        "\tvuexCreateStoreRe   = regexp.MustCompile(`\\bcreateStore\\s*\\(`)\n"
        "\tvuexImportRe        = regexp.MustCompile(`(?:\\bfrom\\s*|\\brequire\\s*\\(\\s*)['\"]vuex['\"]`)\n"
    )
    edit(VUE, [(vuex_vars_old, vuex_vars_new)])
    replace_func(VUE, head_vue, "buildVuexStore")
    edit(PROVIDER, [
        ("\tvuex := buildVuexStore(files, recordsByFile, readContent, knownFiles, manifestImports, shouldStop)\n",
         "\tvar vuex *vuexStore\n\tif needsCallScan {\n\t\tvuex = buildVuexStore(files, recordsByFile, readContent, knownFiles, manifestImports, shouldStop)\n\t}\n"),
    ])
    # The per-file Vuex setup, the per-symbol scan and the top-level scan: take
    # each block from HEAD, anchored on lines that predate the review.
    def block(src, start_marker, end_marker):
        a = src.index(start_marker)
        b = src.index(end_marker, a)
        return src[a:b]

    text = read(PROVIDER)
    old_setup = block(text, "\t\tvuexFile := vuex != nil && needsCallScan", "\t\tfor _, from := range currentFileSymbols {")
    new_setup = block(head_provider, "\t\tvuexFile := vuex != nil && needsCallScan", "\t\tfor _, from := range currentFileSymbols {")
    old_scan = block(text, "\t\t\tif vuexFile && !typeLikeKind(from.Kind) {", "\t\t\tif fileNeedsChannelScan {")
    new_scan = block(head_provider, "\t\t\t// A variable whose value is an object (a mixin, an options object)", "\t\t\tif fileNeedsChannelScan {")
    for old, new in [(old_setup, new_setup), (old_scan, new_scan)]:
        if text.count(old) != 1:
            raise SystemExit("vuex block anchor not unique")
        text = text.replace(old, new)
    top_old = (
        "\t\t\t\t\tif component, ok := vueComponentRecord(recordsByFile[file.Path]); ok {\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tfileSource = component\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t\tfileSource.Language = file.Language\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\t}\n"
        "\t\t\t\t}\n"
    )
    top_new = top_old + (
        "\t\t\t\t// Store strings outside any declaration: a <script setup> body's own\n"
        "\t\t\t\t// `store.dispatch(...)` or a `computed(() => store.getters[...])`.\n"
        "\t\t\t\tif vuexFile {\n"
        "\t\t\t\t\temitVuexCalls(fileSource, topLevel)\n"
        "\t\t\t\t}\n"
    )
    if text.count(top_old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("top-level anchor not unique")
    text = text.replace(top_old, top_new)
    write(PROVIDER, text)
    append_test("TestBuildVuexStoreNeedsComponentsAndAVuexRoot")
    for fixture in ("CounterPanel.vue", "store/modules/counter.js", "mixins/paging.js"):
        copy_head("internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/vue-basic/src/" + fixture)

print(f"folded fixes for step {STEP}")

    "\t// the component.\n"

"""Build the rewritten commit messages from the originals.

usage: python3 -I messages.py OUT_DIR   (run from the repository root)
"""
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

OUT = sys.argv[1]
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
STEPS = ["057ffe60", "e0bc23c4", "020d7285", "94dbe5cd", "e389d440", "22a86389",
         "41f77c74", "bb123214", "0841608c", "0e5d43a5", "bcc4ec88"]
TRAILERS = ("Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>\n"
            "Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/REDACTED\n")
CACHE_RE = re.compile(r"Relation cache\s+versions\s+move\s+\(records\s+v\d+,\s+search\s+v\d+\)(;\s+no symbol changes)?\.")
CACHE_SHARED = "The series' one relation-cache bump (records v26, search v31) covers\nthis change."


def body(commit):
    text = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%B", commit], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    kept = [line for line in text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")
            if not line.startswith(("Co-Authored-By:", "Entire-Checkpoint:", "Claude-Session:"))]
    return "\n".join(kept).rstrip("\n")


def replace(text, old, new):
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"message anchor not unique: {old[:60]!r}")
    return text.replace(old, new)


def shared_cache(text):
    def repl(match):
        return CACHE_SHARED + (" No symbol changes." if match.group(1) else "")
    new, count = CACHE_RE.subn(repl, text)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit("cache sentence not found")
    return new


messages = {}
for step, commit in enumerate(STEPS, start=1):
    text = body(commit)
    if step == 1:
        text = replace(text, "Add a scored Vue corpus with React twins as the parity target",
                       "Add a scored Vue corpus to measure Vue support")
        text = replace(text, "- react/ holds a React twin of each app with the same names and call\n"
                             "  paths. TestVueCorpusReactParity reports the React score on comparable\n"
                             "  facts (384/568 today) next to Vue's (205), and\n"
                             "  TestVueCorpusTwinsMapToSource keeps each twin-map.json honest.\n", "")
    if step == 3:
        text = replace(text, "- IdentityRevision moves to 10: unchanged .vue trees gain symbols.",
                       "- Top-level blocks are found on an ASCII-only lowercase copy that keeps\n"
                       "  the file's byte length: strings.ToLower changes the length of `İ`, the\n"
                       "  Kelvin sign and invalid UTF-8, which would shift script boundaries or\n"
                       "  slice out of range. A test reproduces the panic without this.\n"
                       "- Revision 9, from the HTML-id change earlier in this series, also covers\n"
                       "  this change: the series ships as one change, so it carries one bump.")
    if step == 4:
        text = replace(text, "\nVue corpus: 315 -> 345", "\nThe reader computes each component's script view once per pass; the\n"
                       "relation phase rereads components many times.\n\nVue corpus: 315 -> 345")
    if step in (5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10):
        text = shared_cache(text)
    if step == 5:
        text = replace(text, "- jsImporterExtension carries the .vue case;",
                       "- Extensionless component imports (`./Base`, `@/components/Base`)\n"
                       "  resolve too, with .vue tried after the script extensions, as Vue CLI\n"

#!/bin/sh
# Rebuild one commit of the cleaned series in the current checkout.
# usage: step.sh STEP SOURCE_COMMIT       (run from the repository root)
set -eu
STEP="$1"
SRC="$2"
R="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
OLD_HEAD=7dae62ee

# 1. The original commit's tree; the user's own .claude/settings.json edit stays.
git restore --source="$SRC" --staged --worktree -- . ':(exclude).claude/settings.json'

# 2. Twins out, twin-free harness, README and .graphignore in.
if [ -d internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/react ]; then
  git rm -r -q internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/react
fi
cp "$R/vue_corpus_test.go" internal/sem/vue_corpus_test.go
cp "$R/README.md" internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/README.md
cp "$R/graphignore" .graphignore

# 3. Review fixes: folded for steps 3..9; steps 10 and 11 already have them all,
#    so their files come from the old head.
case "$STEP" in
  3|4|5|6|7|8|9) python3 -I "$R/foldins.py" "$STEP" "$R/head" ;;
  10) git restore --source="$OLD_HEAD" --staged --worktree -- \
        internal/sem/vue.go internal/sem/provider.go internal/sem/vue_test.go \
        internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/vue-basic ;;
  11) git restore --source="$OLD_HEAD" --staged --worktree -- . ':(exclude).claude/settings.json'
      git rm -r -q internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/react
      cp "$R/vue_corpus_test.go" internal/sem/vue_corpus_test.go
      cp "$R/README.md" internal/sem/testdata/vuecorpus/README.md
      cp "$R/graphignore" .graphignore ;;
esac

# 4. One IdentityRevision bump and one cache bump for the series.
python3 -I "$R/normalize.py" "$STEP"

unformatted="$(gofmt -l internal cmd)"
if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
  echo "gofmt: $unformatted" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# 5. Regenerate the generated files.
go test ./internal/sem -run 'TestProviderGoldenSnapshots' -update -count=1 >/dev/null
go test ./internal/sem -run 'TestProviderGoldenFixtureQualityCoverageReport' -count=1 2>&1 | python3 -I "$R/coverage.py" internal/sem/testdata/fixtures/quality_coverage.json
go test ./internal/sem -run 'TestVueCorpusScore' -update -count=1 >/dev/null

# 6. Contract, Vue and corpus tests for this step.
go test ./internal/sem -count=1 -run 'TestVue|TestProviderGolden|TestCapabilit|TestLanguage|TestDocumentedLanguageLists|TestParserIdentity|TestRelationFacts|TestHTMLEntities|TestJSLocalImport|TestBuildVuex|TestVuex|TestDiagnostic|Revisioned|TestImportCapability|TestHeuristic' | tail -1
if [ "$STEP" -ge 11 ]; then
  go test ./internal/cli -count=1 -run 'TestInventoryMention|TestEffectScope' | tail -1
fi

# 7. Commit.
git add -A -- . ':(exclude).claude/settings.json'
git commit -q -F "$R/msg/$STEP.txt"
git log -1 --format='%h %s'

"""Apply the quality coverage report a golden test prints when it drifts.

"""
import sys

path = sys.argv[1]
lines = sys.stdin.read().split("\n")
starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line.strip() == "{"]
if not starts:
    sys.exit(0)
start = starts[0]
indent = len(lines[start]) - len(lines[start].lstrip())
out = []
for line in lines[start:]:
    out.append(line[indent:])
    if line.strip() == "}" and len(line) - len(line.lstrip()) == indent:
        break
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    handle.write("\n".join(out) + "\n")
